## PostStack
class PostStack implements PostProcessor {
    readonly settings: PostSettings;
    readonly quality: PostQuality;
    readonly taa: Taa;
    historyResets: number;
    constructor(renderer: Renderer, patch?: PostSettingsPatch);
    setQuality(patch: Partial<PostQuality>): this;
    set(patch: PostSettingsPatch): this;
    blendTo(patch: PostSettingsPatch, seconds: number, ease?: Ease): this;
    get blending(): boolean;
    finishBlend(): this;
    get exposure(): number;
    get wantsJitter(): boolean;
    get taaActive(): boolean;
    get taaVelocityActive(): boolean;
    get ssrActive(): boolean;
    get motionBlurActive(): boolean;
    advanceBlend(time: number): void;
    resize(width: number, height: number): void;
    encode(encoder: GPUCommandEncoder, inputs: PostInputs, output: GPUTextureView, viewport?: SceneTargetViewport): void;
    destroy(): void;
}
